invariants.rationale: The method always returns an instantiated HoodieWriteMetadata, assigned to 'result' at the beginning.
inputRecords is directly passed as a parameter and always used (e.g., in partition) without null checks.
The HoodieWriteMetadata instance is created and manipulated, and writeStatuses (ultimately stored in result) is always a LinkedList at minimum.
By construction, result contains a List<WriteStatus>.
If sourceReadAndIndexTimer is not null and present, its .get() should not be null.
